scope: 193 released question stems from 41 studies and identities of 15 annotation datasets. These are 208 protocol records, not 208 independent studies.
identity_policy: The release has no standalone global question IDs. Inventory keys use discovery/<source DOI>/q<original question column> and annotation/<source filename>; original row positions and question hashes preserve traceability. Missing question columns are not renumbered.
assessment_scope: All 193 permitted question stems manually assigned workflow prerequisites. Answer columns, answer options, stored predictions and biological matrices do not supply authoring patterns. Task1 identities and broad workflow only; full Task1 notebook and schemas uninspected.

scoring_review.scope: score_answers and accuracy_by_type source reviewed; not executed.
scoring_review.behavior: Exact set match receives full credit. For multiple-answer questions a nonempty strict subset receives half credit, and a set containing an incorrect option receives zero. Single-answer questions require exact set equality.
scoring_review.limits: The source splits answer strings without normalizing whitespace, repeats or letter validity. Its answer-choice reward does not verify biological artifacts; adaptation needs an explicit deterministic evidence contract.
scoring_review.task1: Hierarchy-aware annotation metric advertised; implementation not inspected.
